measurementLimits: Native exercised the production core with a no-UI optimized harness. Tauri IPC/host integration compiled but was not driven in a live desktop.
Record and script tools ran as UID1000 without elevated capabilities or policy changes.
Decoder and Rust parser stream concurrently; decodeAndParseMs is combined wall time, parserCpuMs is parser-thread CPU, moduleIdentityMs only module/build-ID checks.
The target remains busy through decoding; timings are ordinary desktop observations, not isolated overhead benchmarks.
Close and shutdown release loaded data and retain raw output; a forced collector SIGKILL can leave zero decodable samples.
Gained-thread count observes100ms polls and caps retained new identities at4096. Omitted observations can repeat; short-lived threads can escape observation.
